runtimeMapping.normal: Physical single arrow at original Attack .567, speed10/lifetime5; CAST0 reselects at release.
runtimeMapping.s1: Selected full main scale; at arrival selects up to max_target-1 other enemies in native radius1.5 and sends distinct speed6 secondary projectiles with atk_scale_2. Exact native scatter selection order is not recovered.
runtimeMapping.s2: Manual .7 event/full1.333 clip lock, locked selected input. Original native perDamageInterval .15, speed10 then6 after first reach; repeated hits times→times-1 on each new nearby unseen victim. Total arrow lifetime5; born chain retains source after withdrawal.
runtimeMapping.s3: Selected ATK percent/range-forward addition. Original Skill_3 .533 event, .18 triggerDelta/waitAll0, three rounds on up to two targets. One attack lifecycle per multi-target burst.
runtimeMapping.talent1: Selected E1/E2 per-recipient delayed3/2.5 second offensive-only SP. PurposeNONE preserves unhealable allies, source ignores allied isolation. Same-key highest-priority fastest producer is nonstacking; source detach removes owned core.
runtimeMapping.talent2: One positive accepted HP-damage receipt blocked through shieldHits1; selected7/9SP grant at consumed-shield removal. No generic talent duplicate.

limitations: Original C# native selector enum timing3 is unrecovered. S3 reselects each subsequent round as a bounded interpretation; first round retains selected input. Native per-round membership and animation/controller ordering are not frame verified.

Native timeMode0/maxAnimScale-1 animation retiming and cast SP/resume ordering are unrecovered. Adapter uses sampled ASPD ratio for original events and full S2 clip lock; S2 blocks SP until emission, then resumes; the exact native post-release cast-end recovery boundary is unrecovered.

S1 scatter tie ordering and main-hit/secondary-creation ordering are unrecovered. Primary Global description establishes secondary count and distinct victim rule; literal original radius/speed/extra-projectile binding are retained.

S2 native bounce count/BB loader and invalid-target mover dispatch are unrecovered. Description supports descending hit counts; adapter emits a missed arrow toward the saved input position when the unborn input dies/disappears (emitToInputPosWhenTargetIsInvalid1). A lost current victim after birth terminates that mover rather than inventing a new input or revisit; exact native collision/invalid-input dispatch is unrecovered.

S2 repeated-hit hold uses source-independent callbacks between tracked flights. Native projectile rendering/collider/removal during that hold and continuous three-dimensional arc geometry are not reproduced.

Talent1 native priority replacement clock handoff and empty/untargetable source aura details remain bounded interpretations. Same-key timer restarts when producer changes; no stack of duplicate SP ticks.
Talent2 native BlockDamage zero-output, instant-kill/HP-loss, cleanup versus ON_BUFF_FINISH event ordering is unrecovered; adapter follows existing positive accepted ordinary damage shield path.
